We develop a method that enables a student deep net to learn by 'looking' at multiple teacher nets, and that this method outperforms other knowledge exchange methods and fine tuning.
We propose Knowledge Flow which moves 'knowledge', in the form of a learned function, from a zoo of teacher nets, to a new model, called the'student'.
